paragraphs: R' Yaakov son of R' Yose.
Mentioned in Tanchuma, Behaalotcha 11, and at the beginning of Pesikta Rabbati, Ki Tisa.[^1]

notes.text: פס׳ רבתי is read contextually as Pesikta Rabbati; ר״פ marks the beginning of the Tisa section, conventionally Ki Tisa, without forcing chapter rather than parashah. בהעלתך־יא gives Behaalotcha 11, without adding a section-sign claim. Neither locator is independently checked against a named edition. Both personal title components remain R'.
